stem: Who first used the word "Sarvodaya"?'
expl: Sarvodaya is formed from two Sanskrit words—sarva (meaning: all) and udaya (meaning: upliftment). The word Sarvodaya was used for the first time by Mahatma Gandhi. stem: Which of the following was Gandhiji's first Satyagraha Movement in India in which he used civil disobedience?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The Champaran Movement (1917) was Gandhiji’s first Satyagraha movement in India, in which he used civil disobedience. This Satyagraha was started as a protest against the ‘Tinkathia system’ prevalent in Champaran (Bihar) in the early 19th century. After the Champaran Satyagraha, Gandhiji used Satyagraha in 1918 when he intervened in the dispute between the cotton mill owners and workers in Ahmedabad over the plague bonus. In the same year, 1918, Gandhiji started the Kheda Satyagraha in Gujarat because, despite crops being destroyed, the British government did not grant remission in land revenue. It may be noted that Gandhiji began the Rowlatt Satyagraha in 1919 in protest against the ‘Rowlatt Act’ passed by the British government.

stem: Who invited Gandhiji to come to Champaran?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above More than one of the above

expl: After returning from South Africa in January 1915, Gandhiji carried out his first successful Satyagraha in Bihar’s Champaran district in 1917. In 1916, a Champaran farmer, Rajkumar Shukla, met Gandhiji in Lucknow and urged him to visit Champaran. The Champaran issue was quite old. By the end of the 19th century, German synthetic dyes replaced indigo in the market. As a result, the European plantation owners in Champaran were forced to stop indigo cultivation. The peasants too wanted to get rid of indigo cultivation as a cash crop. Taking advantage of the peasants helplessness, the white planters arbitrarily increased rent and other illegal taxes in the name of releasing them from their contracts. It was against this exploitation of the peasants that Gandhiji began the Champaran Satyagraha.
